arxiv-2109-13243.title: Presenting Unbinned Differential Cross Section Results
arxiv-2109-13243.creator: Miguel Arratia, Anja Butter, Mario Campanelli, Vincent Croft, Dag Gillberg, Aishik Ghosh, Kristin Lohwasser, Bogdan Malaescu, Vinicius Mikuni, Benjamin Nachman, Juan Rojo, Jesse Thaler, Ramon Winterhalder
arxiv-2109-13243.description: Abstract Machine learning tools have empowered a qualitatively new way to perform differential cross section measurements whereby the data are unbinned, possibly in many dimensions. Unbinned measurements can enable, improve, or at least simplify comparisons between experiments and with theoretical predictions. Furthermore, many-dimensional measurements can be used to define observables after the measurement instead of before.

arxiv-2201-09975.title: Learning Task-Parameterized Skills from Few Demonstrations
arxiv-2201-09975.creator: Jihong Zhu, Michael Gienger, and Jens Kober
arxiv-2201-09975.description: Abstract Moving away from repetitive tasks, robots nowadays demand versatile skills that adapt to different situations. Task-parameterized learning improves the generalization of motion policies by encoding relevant contextual information in the task parameters, hence enabling flexible task executions. However, training such a policy often requires collecting multiple demonstrations in different situations.

arxiv-2207-05308.title: Capacity-Insensitive Algorithms for Online Facility Assignment Problems on a Line Thanks: This work was partially supported by joint project of Kyoto University and Toyota Motor Corporation, titled “Advanced Mathematical Science for Mobility Society.”
arxiv-2207-05308.creator: Tsubasa Harada, Toshiya Itoh, Shuichi Miyazaki
arxiv-2207-05308.description: Abstract Abstract: In the online facility assignment problem {\rm OFA}(k,\ell) , there exist k servers with a capacity \ell\geq 1 on a metric space and a request arrives one-by-one. The task of an online algorithm is to irrevocably match a current request with one of the servers with vacancies before the next request arrives.

arxiv-2312-01350.title: Honesty Is the Best Policy: Defining and Mitigating AI Deception
arxiv-2312-01350.creator: Francis Rhys Ward, Francesco Belardinelli, Francesca Toni, Tom Everitt
arxiv-2312-01350.description: Abstract Deceptive agents are a challenge for the safety, trustworthiness, and cooperation of AI systems. We focus on the problem that agents might deceive in order to achieve their goals (for instance, in our experiments with language models, the goal of being evaluated as truthful).

arxiv-2312-09956.title: An artificial neural network approach to finding the key length of the Vigenère cipher
arxiv-2312-09956.creator: Christian Millichap, Yeeka Yau
arxiv-2312-09956.description: Abstract . In this article, we create an artificial neural network (ANN) that combines both classical and modern techniques for determining the key length of a Vigenère cipher. We provide experimental evidence supporting the accuracy of our model for a wide range of parameters.

arxiv-2312-12938.title: CARGO: Crypto-Assisted Differentially Private Triangle Counting without Trusted Servers
arxiv-2312-12938.creator: Shang Liu, Yang Cao, Takao Murakami, Jinfei Liu, Masatoshi Yoshikawa
arxiv-2312-12938.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Shang Liu, Yang Cao, Takao Murakami, Jinfei Liu, Masatoshi Yoshikawa. Differentially private triangle counting in graphs is essential for analyzing connection patterns and calculating clustering coefficients while protecting sensitive individual information. Previous works have relied on either central or local models to enforce differential privacy. However, a significant utility gap exists between the central and local models of differentially private triangle counting, depending on whether or not a trusted server is needed.

arxiv-2404-02076.title: Green Measures for a Class of non-Markov Processes
arxiv-2404-02076.creator: Herry Pribawanto Suryawan, José Luís da Silva
arxiv-2404-02076.description: Abstract In this paper, we investigate the Green measure for a class of non-Gaussian processes in ℝ d \mathbb{R}^{d} . These measures are associated with the family of generalized grey Brownian motions B β , α B_{\beta,\alpha} , 0 < β ≤ 1 0<\beta\leq 1 , 0 < α ≤ 2 0<\alpha\leq 2 .

arxiv-2407-14313.title: Scattering of kinks in coreless potentials
arxiv-2407-14313.creator: Ondřej Nicolas Karpíšek, Lukáš Rafaj, Filip Blaschke
arxiv-2407-14313.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Ondřej Nicolas Karpíšek, Lukáš Rafaj, Filip Blaschke. We explore the relevance of the central hill for a symmetric double-well potential and its impact on the scattering of kinks in a scalar field theory in (1+1)-dimensions. This region controls the inner core structure of the kink. We study how the disappearance of analyticity in this region of the potential affects the resonant features in K ​ K ¯ K\bar{K} scattering.

arxiv-2411-02517.title: The 𝒊 ​ 𝜺 i\varepsilon -Prescription for String Amplitudes and Regularized Modular Integrals
arxiv-2411-02517.creator: Jan Manschot, Zhi-Zhen Wang
arxiv-2411-02517.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Jan Manschot, Zhi-Zhen Wang. We study integrals appearing in one-loop amplitudes in string theory, and in particular their analytic continuation based on a string theoretic analog of the i ​ ε i\varepsilon -prescription of quantum field theory. For various zero- and two-point one-loop amplitudes of both open and closed strings, we prove that this analytic continuation is equivalent to a regularization using generalized exponential integrals. Our approach provides exact expressions in terms of the degeneracies at each mass level.

pmc-10558788.title: Photopolymerized keratin-PGLa hydrogels for antibiotic resistance reversal and enhancement of infectious wound healing
pmc-10558788.creator: Changfa Sun, Wenjie Liu, Lili Wang, Run Meng, Jia Deng, Rui Qing, Bochu Wang, Shilei Hao
pmc-10558788.description: Infectious wounds have become serious challenges for both treatment and management in clinical practice, so development of new antibiotics has been considered an increasingly difficult task. Here, we report the design and synthesis of keratin 31 (K31)-peptide glycine-leucine-amide (PGLa) photopolymerized hydrogels to rescue the antibiotic activity of antibiotics for infectious wound healing promotion.

pmc-10604898.title: Newborns with Favourable Outcomes after Perinatal Asphyxia Have Upregulated Glucose Metabolism-Related Proteins in Plasma
pmc-10604898.creator: Ping K Yip, Michael Bremang, Ian Pike, Vennila Ponnusamy, Adina T Michael-Titus, Divyen K Shah, Adrián Velázquez Campoy
pmc-10604898.description: Hypoxic-ischaemic encephalopathy (HIE) is an important cause of morbidity and mortality globally. Although mild therapeutic hypothermia (TH) may improve outcomes in selected babies, the mechanism of action is not fully understood. A proteomics discovery study was carried out to analyse proteins in the plasma of newborns with HIE.

pmc-11325022.title: Soliton structures of fractional coupled Drinfel’d–Sokolov–Wilson equation arising in water wave mechanics
pmc-11325022.creator: Nur Hasan Mahmud Shahen, Md Al Amin, Foyjonnesa, M M Rahman
pmc-11325022.description: This article delves into the dynamic constructions of distinctive traveling wave solutions for wave circulation in shallow water mechanics, specifically addressing the time-fractional couple Drinfel’d–Sokolov–Wilson (DSW) equation. Introducing the previously untapped exp(-ϕ(ξ))-expansion method, we successfully generate a diverse set of analytic solutions expressed in hyperbolic, trigonometric, and rational functions, each with permitted parameters.

pmc-11422044.title: Case report: A rare heterozygous Hb CS with heterozygous HbE in a family with thalassemia in China
pmc-11422044.creator: Di Wang, Han Zhang, Zhuo Yang, Wei Su, Yaling Dou, Yingchun Xu
pmc-11422044.description: Thalassemia is a hemoglobin disease characterized by reduced or complete absence of the production of the α/β globin gene. Currently, the detection of β-thalassemia carriers is based on differences in blood cell parameters. However, β-thalassemia carriers cannot be distinguished from α- and β-thalassemia co-inherited carriers based solely on hematological findings, and the differential diagnosis must rely on molecular diagnosis.

pmc-11464600.title: Investigating the causal relationship between inflammatory bowel disease and simple appendicitis using Mendelian randomization
pmc-11464600.creator: Yawei Zhang, Lichao Yang, Lianwen Yuan
pmc-11464600.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). The relationship between simple appendicitis and inflammatory bowel disease (IBD) is not clear. In this study, we approach the issue from a genetic perspective, using Mendelian randomization (MR) tools to explore the potential causal connection between the two. We used GWAS data from 12,882 IBD patients (21,770 controls), 5956 crohn’s disease (CD) patients (14,927 controls), 6968 ulcerative colitis (UC) patients (20,464 controls), and 4604 simple appendicitis patients (481,880 controls).

pmc-11683652.title: Metaphor Diffusion in Online Health Communities: Infodemiology Study in a Stroke Online Health Community
pmc-11683652.creator: Sara Khoshnaw, Pietro Panzarasa, Anna De Simoni, Naomi Cahill
pmc-11683652.description: BackgroundOnline health communities (OHCs) enable patients to create social ties with people with similar health conditions outside their existing social networks. Harnessing mechanisms of information diffusion in OHCs has attracted attention for its ability to improve illness self-management without the use of health care resources.

pmc-12642388.title: Effect of Brain Stimulation on Effort Is Task Dependent: Evidence From an HD‐tDCS Study on Cardiovascular Responses
pmc-12642388.creator: David Framorando, Sarah Delobel, Andrea Razzetto
pmc-12642388.description: This study tested the effect of frontal hemispheric asymmetry (FHA) on mental effort in tasks of fixed and unfixed difficulty. To manipulate FHA, we applied high‐definition transcranial direct current stimulation (HD‐tDCS) to the dorsolateral prefrontal cortex (dlPFC) and assessed its impact on cardiovascular responses.

pmc-12965892.title: Pre-Operative Bone Health in Elective Spine Surgery, From Risk Assessment to Optimization Strategies: A Narrative Review
pmc-12965892.creator: Mitchell K. Ng, Morgan Hitchner, Jonathan Dalton, Yulia Lee, William A. Green, Gregorio Baek, Joshua Mathew, Yasmine K. Eichbaum, Alan S. Hilibrand, Alexander R. Vaccaro, Gregory D. Schroeder, Christopher K. Kepler
pmc-12965892.description: Study DesignNarrative Review.ObjectivesBone health optimization before spine surgery is an important but overlooked determinant of long-term postoperative outcomes. Compromised bone quality is associated with hardware loosening, pseudoarthrosis, proximal junctional failure, and revision surgery. This narrative review aims to highlight the importance of preoperative bone optimization and propose a pragmatic clinical pathway for spine surgeons.

Ceasing chloroquine use restored chloroquine-sensitive strains in many African countries. pmc-13465317.title: Intraoperative management of accelerated idioventricular rhythm triggered by tourniquet deflation: a case report and mechanistic insights
pmc-13465317.creator: Jueheng Wu, Xiaohan Yang, Yalei Gao, Liang Guo, Fan Yang
pmc-13465317.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). BackgroundAccelerated idioventricular rhythm (AIVR) is a common reperfusion arrhythmia, but reports of AIVR triggered by tourniquet deflation in orthopedic trauma surgery are rare.Case presentationA 59-year-old male with left tibiofibular open fracture underwent emergency open reduction and internal fixation. Recurrent AIVR and severe hemodynamic instability occurred twice immediately after tourniquet deflation, with wide QRS complexes, atrioventricular dissociation, and transient ST-segment depression, which was initially misdiagnosed as acute myocardial ischemia.
